definition: Automatically producing questions from a passage, often ones whose answers appear in the text.
details: Automatically producing questions from a passage, often ones whose answers appear in the text. It is used to synthesize QA training data, study materials, and dialogue prompts.

explainer.lead: Generating questions from text creates training data and study material without manual authoring. It turns passages into practice questions whose answers are in the text.

tiers.eli5: It’s like a teacher writing quiz questions directly from the textbook chapter.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to synthesize QA training pairs and dialogue prompts; a pitfall is generating questions whose answers are trivial or not actually in the passage.
tiers.paperLevel: Automatically producing questions from a passage, often ones whose answers appear in the text; used to synthesize QA training data, study materials, and dialogue prompts.

explainer.example: From “The mitochondria produce energy,” the system generates “What do mitochondria produce?” with answer “energy.”
